text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I feel like my training is starting
to pay
off.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
This isn't so bad of a result... I d-do feel
a little
more confident now...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Just maybe... I could work my way up to
the front with a
bit more effort...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Hyaaah?! D-did I say that out loud?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
S-s-sorry, but could you pretend you
didn't hear
that?! I understand I don't
have what it takes!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I should be realistic, take baby steps,
start off
with smaller goals... That's what
I need to do!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list:
Today proved you have what it takes to aim
higher!
Let's knock off those goals one at a time.

text_block_list.text:
R-really?! You really feel that way about
me?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm clumsy, with a long line of mistakes
and
slipups... But if you believe I can,
Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: R-right! I can't continue on like this!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I don't have the elegance of Opera O, or
Shakur's
analytical skills...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
And I'm bad at everything else, too... I
have too
many obstacles to overcome!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Let's take things one at a time.

text_block_list.text:
O-okay! I have a lot of areas to make up
for, but I
promise to take on whatever
training you give
me!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Urk... Sorry, I m-mixed my words
together in such
an important moment.
I'll keep on trying my best!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
